svg.text: a number on a line: its length in Å
a residue in contact: its side chain from Cα, its backbone where that makes the contact
what is nearer to the reader lies over what is farther, which is thinner and paler
a contact is drawn for the first ligand, and weighted by how many of the 3 ligands make it with that residue (k/3)
10 contacts of dexamethasone with a residue, by kind: 5 of them are made by all 3 ligands. 4 contacts that another ligand makes and dexamethasone does
not are not drawn: hydrophobic contact with residue 563 (2/3), water bridge with residue 608 (2/3), π–π stacking with residue 623 (1/3) and 1 more. The
models are fitted on the first with 0.5, 0.6 Å over the backbone around the ligands.
